prisoner.name: Jason Watson
prisoner.aka: Maj. Jason P. Watson; Major Jason Watson
prisoner.description: Jason P. Watson is a U.S. Air Force major held in pretrial confinement while facing military charges arising from his public criticism of President Donald Trump. He was arrested after protesting in uniform on the U.S. Capitol steps on July 1, 2026, calling for Trump’s impeachment and removal. The Air Force ordered him into pretrial confinement on August 18, after another public interview. Prosecutors preferred ten specifications under the Uniform Code of Military Justice on August 24. An Article 32 preliminary hearing took place on September 18. In October, his attorney said he remained in solitary confinement around the clock. Watson maintains that he acted to uphold his constitutional oath. He is presumed innocent; no conviction or sentence is recorded.
prisoner.body: Sources: CNN: pretrial confinement; CNN: military charges; Stars and Stripes: preliminary hearing; CNN: attorney’s confinement account.

case.charges: UCMJ Article 88: three specifications of contempt toward officials; Article 92: five specifications of disobeying orders; Article 133: two specifications of conduct unbecoming an officer.
case.indicted: Military charges preferred August 24, 2026. Article 32 preliminary hearing held September 18, 2026; final court-martial referral not confirmed in retrieved reporting.
case.sentence: Pretrial confinement; no sentence imposed or conviction reported as of October 12, 2026. The July Capitol arrest and subsequent base restriction are not treated as continuous imprisonment from July 1.

sources.supports: CNN confirms military pretrial confinement ordered August 18, following the July 1 protest arrest; Maryland county facility reported in August.
Charges preferred August 24: 3 Article 88, 5 Article 92 and 2 Article 133 specifications; Air Force confirms continued confinement and presumption of innocence.
Defense counsel identifies full name Jason P. Watson and September 18 Article 32 hearing at Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling.
On-site reporting confirms September 18 hearing; age 40 reported but exact birthday unverified; military and defense arguments remain disputed.
Attorney says Watson remains in solitary confinement around the clock; statement attributed rather than treated as an independently verified condition.
Named personal legal-defense fundraiser organized by Major Jason Watson Legal Trust; website field is a support link, not a news source.

entries.research_limits: Exact DOB, current institution, inmate number, and a verified reusable portrait remain unresolved. Do not infer a birth year from a reported age. July arrest is described in the biography but the counter starts with verified August 18 pretrial confinement. August Maryland reporting and September hearing references do not establish a verified current jail; leave state, facility and coordinates unset.
